Class DeleteOptions

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.DeleteOptions
public class DeleteOptions extends Object
Options for deleting a path. All supplied conditions must hold for deletion to proceed. An unsupported option fails with Unsupported and a false condition fails with ConditionNotMatch. Optional reference fields default to null.

  • Field Details

    • version

      public final String version
      Selects a stored version to delete. Requires service support for deleting versions.

    • recursive

      public final boolean recursive
      Deletes the target recursively. Defaults to false. Use a trailing slash to restrict deletion to the directory. On prefix-based services, a path such as "a" can also match entries under "ab/".

    • ifMatch

      public final String ifMatch
      Deletes only when the current file has this exact ETag. A missing file fails the condition. Only concrete ETags are portable.

    • ifNoneMatch

      public final String ifNoneMatch
      Deletes only when the current file has a different ETag or is missing. Only concrete ETags are portable.

    • ifVersionMatch

      public final String ifVersionMatch
      Deletes only when the current file has this exact version. A missing file fails the condition.

    • ifVersionNotMatch

      public final String ifVersionNotMatch
      Deletes only when the current file has a different version. The behavior for a missing file depends on the service.

    • ifNotChanged

      public final Metadata ifNotChanged
      Deletes only when the current file still has the identity recorded in metadata previously returned by OpenDAL for the same path. OpenDAL uses a version match when the service supports it and a version is present, or a non-weak ETag when available. Metadata with neither identity fails with ConfigInvalid. A conflicting explicit match condition fails with ConditionNotMatch.
